voiceover.script: If you're going to Disney, please don't make my mistakes. Hokas? Four out of ten. Super cushy at rope drop, but by lunch my knees were done. Nike Air Max? Five out of ten. Cute, but that narrow toe box had me hunting for a bench by hour five. These? Ten out of ten. The toe box is actually wide, so your feet can swell and still feel fine. And the arch support doesn't quit at two p.m. Twenty-two thousand steps, and my feet were still happy at the fireworks.

primary_text:
Disney means 8–10 hours on your feet: cobblestones, lines, and miles between rides. Most sneakers are built for running, not for standing in line at hour seven.

The ComfortWear Ortho Stretch Shoe:
👣 Wide toe box, so swollen feet still have room
🦶 Arch support that's still there at the fireworks
☁️ Cushioned rocker sole for 20,000-step park days

Pack the shoes that make it to the fireworks 🎆
